description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android note-taking app. It manages the UI components such as RecyclerView, Toolbar with search functionality, FloatingActionButton for creating notes, and interactions like searching, opening note details, and deleting notes with undo. It interfaces with NoteRepository for data operations and NoteAdapter for displaying notes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling the display and interaction with list of notes, search functionality, and navigation to other activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up search, and event handlers.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the list of notes when activity resumes.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Performs note search by querying the repository and updating the adapter.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads all notes from the repository and refreshes the list.

methods.name: onNoteClicked
methods.description: Handles note item clicks by opening the detail activity.

methods.name: onNoteLongPressed
methods.description: Handles long press on a note to delete with undo option via Snackbar.
